name: Cascade
description: Replays little loops of what you just played, stacked at octave (and fifth) speeds in a pattern you can hear, so one note comes back as a shimmering, rhythmic cascade of itself.

params.name: Pattern
params.description: How each captured slice is replayed. Mosaic stacks loops at several speeds at once. Strum retriggers the start of the slice in a quickening or slowing run. Tunnel loops a short piece of it into a drone that grows longer and darker. Steps plays each repeat at the next speed, like an arpeggio of the note.

params.name: Time
params.description: The length of each captured slice and the pulse the replays fall on. Short times give a fast glittering stutter; long times replay whole phrases.

params.name: Repeats
params.description: How many times each slice comes back before it stops, which is how long the cascade lasts after you stop playing.

params.name: Decay
params.description: How much quieter and darker each repeat is than the one before. At zero every repeat is as loud and bright as the first.

params.name: High
params.description: Level of the replays that run faster than you played, so they sound an octave or more above and repeat in the gaps.

params.name: Low
params.description: Level of a half-speed replay: the slice an octave down and twice as long, underneath the rest.

params.name: Interval
params.description: Which speeds the faster replays use. Octaves keeps everything on the note you played; Octaves and fifths adds replays a fifth above, which also fall in a three against two rhythm.

params.name: Shape
params.description: The envelope of every replay. Low gives sharp plucked fronts that die away; high makes each one swell in and out so the pattern blurs into a wash.

params.name: Reverse
params.description: The chance that a replay runs backwards. Zero is all forwards; full is all backwards.

params.name: Spread
params.description: How far the replays are placed to the left and right. The faster ones sit furthest out and alternate sides; the half-speed one stays in the middle.

params.name: Tone
params.description: Takes the highs off all the replays. Lower settings make the cascade softer and further away.

params.name: Mix
params.description: Balance between the dry signal and the cascade.

origin.note: Written for live-mix on cpp/kit. In the family of micro-looping pedals: the input is cut into slices on a clock and each slice is replayed by a pool of windowed loop voices at integer and 3:2 speed ratios (time-domain transposition of windowed fragments, as in Curtis Roads, 'Microsound', 2001). Faster voices read half-band decimated copies of the buffer so they do not alias (the mip-map of Lance Williams, 'Pyramidal Parametrics', 1983, applied to audio). Not a model of any unit.
